description: This file is a Markdown document describing the 'CompositeInput' HAL interface for a multimedia platform. It provides a comprehensive overview, including functional specifications, API details, state machine diagrams, configuration examples, and operational guidelines for the compositing input hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Describes the capabilities of a specific composite input port, including supported properties, metrics, and features.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a port including connection and signal information.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum describing various signal states such as NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Holds information about the current video resolution and format of the input signal.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Contains telemetry metrics like lock time, signal drops, and uptime for a port.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used for batch property retrievals, with the value as a union type.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing a property, including type, read-only status, and description.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the port, including supported properties and metrics.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port interface for a given port ID.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for port events such as connection and signal changes.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Fetches individual or multiple property values supporting discovery and batching.
